name: subagent-models
description: Turn subagent models and agent types on or off and set the effort subagents run at, as defaults in /config or live for one session with /subagent-models.

opus.title: Opus subagents
opus.description: on lets a subagent run on opus; off moves it to the default model

fable.title: Fable subagents
fable.description: on lets a subagent run on fable; off moves it to the default model

sonnet.title: Sonnet subagents
sonnet.description: on lets a subagent run on sonnet; off moves it to the default model

haiku.title: Haiku subagents
haiku.description: on lets a subagent run on haiku; off moves it to the default model

defaultModel.title: Default subagent model
defaultModel.description: The model a turned-off model moves to

effort.title: Subagent effort
effort.description: The effort every subagent request runs at; inherit keeps the request's own

offAction.title: When a spawn names a turned-off model
offAction.description: move runs it on the default model; deny refuses the spawn

applyToRunning.title: Effort changes reach running subagents
applyToRunning.description: on moves running subagents to a new effort on their next request; off keeps each one at the effort it started with until you apply it

disabledAgents.title: Turned-off agent types
disabledAgents.description: Comma-separated agent types subagents may not run as, such as Explore, Plan

staleDays.title: Days before a skill counts as unused
staleDays.description: A skill last used more than this many days ago counts as unused in the skills panel

disabledSkills.title: Turned-off skills
disabledSkills.description: Comma-separated skills the model may not follow, such as pstack:tdd, simplify
